statements.text:
We are in the midst of one of the most consequential eras of innovation in human history: Artificial Intelligence.

Our military must stay on the cutting edge of technology.

The FY25 #NDAA boosts innovation by providing for the development and deployment of AI, quantum computing, and autonomous systems.

The FY25 #NDAA will:

→ Restore American deterrence
→ Support modernizing our nuclear triad
→ Boost innovation by advancing AI
→ Expand counter drone efforts

This bill is focused on strengthening our military.

President @realDonaldTrump's commitment to innovation is clear:

→ Blockchain: Supporting cutting-edge financial technologies.

→ Space Exploration: Partnerships like @SpaceX and @NASA to lead the future.

→ AI Advancements: Encouraging American leadership in tech.

→ Business Freedom: Reducing government red tape to let innovators thrive.

We are entering the golden age of America.

TUNE IN TOMORROW: He's a video game developer, Artificial Intelligence expert, and represents the conservative values of California's 23rd District...

This week we're talking with @JayObernolte!!!

You won't want to miss this fascinating discussion--we're talking all things AI. From the effect it will have on everyday Americans' jobs to the future it has in our Armed Services.

The expanding use of artificial intelligence across America comes with massive opportunities, as well as significant risks. As big businesses—which have the financial and human resources needed to invest in this technology—continue to lead the development and adoption of AI, Main Street is being left behind. That’s why we’re introducing the AI for Main Street Act to provide small businesses with the resources, education, and training needed to utilize artificial intelligence.

statements.text:
💡 Small businesses are the backbone of our economy,  but as AI transforms how we work— Main Street needs a fair shot at innovation.

That’s why I introduced the AI for Main Street Act to make AI tools, training, and support accessible to every small business in MO-04 and America.

Main Street deserves a seat at the AI table.

That’s why I introduced the AI for Main Street Act with @RepScholten — to help small businesses learn, adapt, and compete in the age of AI.

America’s future isn’t just in Silicon Valley — it’s on Main Street. 💪🤖👇

https://t.co/2cX1BNgoxK
